catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source-mapped rules · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Fresh official catalogue and binary PDFs inspected. Source-to-rule matrix and boundary tests retained; declared source conflicts and manual/noncomputable domains are not resolved by software testing. Independent clinical/pharmacy review remains pending.

organ_function_reconciliation.note: Structured renal/hepatic component rules were reconciled to the current official NCCP regimen source. Independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation remains pending.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.schedule_summary: Cetuximab on Day 1 and Day 8. Day 1 FOLFIRI includes irinotecan, folinic acid and fluorouracil, followed by a 46-hour fluorouracil infusion with planned disconnection around Day 3. Repeat the reference cycle every 14 days while beneficial and tolerable.

retrospective_service_audit.scope: Fresh source-first threshold, component-hold, recovery, dose-history and missing-pathway audit; see retained matrix and before/after engine cases.

monitoring_source_conflict.note: Observation source conflict: NCCP permits stopping the post-infusion observation/vital-sign schedule after two tolerated doses, whereas current Erbitux SmPC section 4.2 requires close monitoring during and for at least one hour after each infusion. The clinical team must reconcile this and prescribe the local observation plan; do not promise earlier discharge.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: NCCP 00328 v7 source mapping reviewed in SACTCheck v0.84.34. Independent consultant/pharmacy validation and clinical authorisation remain pending. Declared source conflicts and manual domains require review; missing values are not normal results.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Source reconciled in SACTCheck v0.59.0; independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation pending.

acneiform_rash_grade.label: Current cetuximab skin toxicity grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No acneiform rash.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Papules/pustules covering under 10% body-surface area, with or without pruritus or tenderness.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Papules/pustules covering 10-30% body-surface area with or without symptoms and psychosocial/instrumental-ADL impact, or over 30% with mild symptoms.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Papules/pustules covering over 30% body-surface area with moderate/severe symptoms, limiting self-care ADL, or local superinfection requiring oral antibiotics.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Life-threatening consequences, or extensive superinfection requiring IV antibiotics.

options.description: No infusion-related or hypersensitivity reaction.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Mild transient reaction; interruption of the infusion is not indicated; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Infusion interruption or treatment is indicated, with prompt response to symptomatic medication; prophylaxis may be needed for 24 hours or less.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Prolonged symptoms not rapidly responsive to treatment/brief interruption, or recurrence after initial improvement; hospitalisation indicated for clinical sequelae.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

eligibility: Indication as listed in the current official NCCP regimen
Performance status and organ function appropriate for the selected treatment
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component
Pregnancy or breastfeeding where prohibited by the current source
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal and liver profile; assess treatment-specific toxicity and repeat blood tests during treatment as specified in the NCCP source.
Before cetuximab: review previous antibody infusion reactions, red-meat allergy, tick bites and any cetuximab IgE testing.
After the final cetuximab dose: monthly electrolytes, magnesium and calcium for two months.
Disease monitoring and imaging follow the individual consultant treatment plan; no fixed tumour-marker or imaging interval is prescribed by this regimen.
FBC, renal and liver profile before every cycle; weekly FBC during a cytopenia-related delay.
DPD testing before first fluorouracil; ECG where cardiac function is compromised; INR as clinically indicated during warfarin therapy.
Interpret uracil-based DPD phenotype cautiously in moderate/severe renal impairment; consider genotype testing.

Observation source conflict: NCCP permits stopping the post-infusion observation/vital-sign schedule after two tolerated doses, whereas current Erbitux SmPC section 4.2 requires close monitoring during and for at least one hour after each infusion. The clinical team must reconcile this and prescribe the local observation plan; do not promise earlier discharge.
dose_modifications: Use source-mapped component rules below. Relative reductions require the actual current component dose level; do not assume level 0. Source ambiguities require consultant/pharmacy clarification.

AST threshold is the source absolute-result entry, not an ALT result or ULN multiple; unit interpretation and equality at bilirubin 85/AST 180 require consultant/pharmacy review. Folinic acid follows bolus 5-FU hold/omission.

Confirm DPD result, line/pump care and fluorouracil cardiac warning symptoms.
